_comment: Story 8.4 (8.4-GOLDEN-01) — the LOCK-STATE lifecycle golden. Pins the is_locked / lifecycle-state outcome across the quote/PDF/attachment + acceptance-evidence lifecycle. Every case is origin 'new-expected': NO real Lovable lock oracle exists (Lovable allowed MUTABLE attachments + acceptance evidence — the documented 8.4-DOCS-01 delta), so Phase A's lock is a deliberate, safer NEW behavior. The three-way origin/schema guard is kept so an Epic-9 delta lands without a code-shape change. Lock-STATE only (no money), but every numeric value stays < 10 digits (R-717/orgnr-scan safe). NO PII.

policy.acceptanceLocksWhen: the quote_acceptances row exists (AR704 has no draft state)
policy.archiveOnlyDelete: a locked file is archive-only (locked -> archived); never a hard delete (architecture §14)

cases.note: A DRAFT version's quote_pdf link is NOT locked — the 6.3 preview-on-draft retry path must stay re-pointable.
Once the parent version is SENT the quote_pdf link locks by construction (parent-state-keyed apply); the file lifecycle flips to locked.
A sent version's quote_attachment_snapshot link locks alongside the PDF (both carry commitment identity once sent).
An accepted (non-draft) version's PDF link stays locked — locking activates at any non-draft parent state, not only 'sent'.
The acceptance_evidence link locks the moment the quote_acceptances row exists (AR704 has no draft state — always immutable).
Deletion of a locked file is archive-only: locked -> archived (never a hard delete). architecture §14 / R-813.
